title: Sensor status change (NORMAL / WARNING / CRITICAL)
description: Value of the records on factorymind.telemetry.sensor-status. Producer: telemetry-service. Consumers: alert-service. Record key: assetId. New optional fields may be added; removing or renaming a field, or adding an enum value, needs the consumers first (see contracts/README.md).

previousStatus.description: Status before this reading; null for the first reading of the sensor

value.description: The reading that changed the status

unit.description: Unit of the value; null when the sensor definition is not known yet

warningThreshold.description: Limit in force; null when the sensor definition is not known yet

criticalThreshold.description: Limit in force; null when the sensor definition is not known yet
